regime_context: The TSX thematic detector shows Big Banks as the dominant, eligible, and crowded leader with broad participation and high durability. The absolute trend gate is active and historically helped control drawdown. No confirmed rotation handoff; the breadth of eligible themes is broad (11 of 16). Momentum rank-IC is insignificant, so ranks serve as a concentration lens, not a return forecast.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: The theme exhibits the strongest trend health (eligible, high durability, full breadth), but crowding (z=1.76) cautions against excessive size; an overweight lean reflects the trend-following risk discipline, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Crowding could trigger a sharp mean-reversion if macro conditions sour; the trend may be mature.

falsifier.text: Durability bar falls below 0.6 OR breadth drops below 0.8.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: The theme fails the absolute trend gate (eligible=false), indicating elevated drawdown risk relative to eligible peers; an underweight lean aligns with the gate's validated risk control.
theses.dissent: Gold miners could surge unexpectedly if geopolitical or inflation fears spike; the gate may lag.

falsifier.text: Durability bar rises above 0.5 AND breadth expands to >=0.5, or it becomes eligible.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Despite a trending hurst tag, the theme is ineligible (failed gate) and has negative score; an underweight lean reduces exposure to a theme the gate deems risky for shake-outs.
theses.dissent: The strong trend and broad participation could persist; the gate may be a false negative.

falsifier.text: Becomes eligible (trend gate passes) and breadth stays above 0.7.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
